title: Dormancy, reactivation and unclaimed balance policy
workflow: Load institution-approved dormancy policy and exclusions
Compute candidate inactivity from authoritative qualifying events
Notify and review account for restrictions/legal holds
Activate dormant state only after approved policy checks
Require identity, mandate and risk reevaluation before reactivation
Preserve financial obligations, balances and regulatory records
invariants: No universal inactivity duration is assumed
Reactivation requires effective mandate and risk checks
Dormancy state alone cannot produce balancing ledger entries
Retain history of customer notices and decisions
planned_tests: Excluded transaction does not reset clock
Dormant account cannot bypass restrictions through API
approval_gate: Bank dormancy and unclaimed-property policy, signed jurisdictional sources, compliance review.
